text: How much time do you have? The short version is that while there's not necessarily anything wrong with them in principle, in practice there's a pretty impressive amount of exploitation at nearly every level of the industry. story: Manufactured housing: the Ugly Duckling of affordable housing
text: Wikipedia has an article on manufactured housing, including a picutre and description: [LINK] It seems to have a specific meaning, and you might expect something different when thinking about "mobile homes" or "prefab houses" in your region. (e.g., I think of something different for prefabs in germany) There also was an episode on mobile homes of last week tonight which i found interesting back in the day: [VIDEO] They often have to rent the land they are on and get stuck there, as they can't transport the houses off.
